sources.title: Lark CLI: Put your AI to work in Lark - Lark CLI - Documentation - Lark Developer

identity.description: Lark (Larksuite) is a workplace collaboration suite; the Lark Developer open platform offers 2500+ APIs (Contacts, Messenger, Docs, Base, Sheet, Wiki, Approval, Calendar, etc.), bots, web apps, blocks and an open-source Lark CLI.
identity.identity_notes: Sources are from the official Lark Developer site open.larksuite.com.

auth.oauth_flows: CLI uses OAuth authorization code via 'lark-cli auth login' (user identity); tenant access token also referenced for app identity.
auth.scopes_notes: Missing permissions are granted via auth login --scope; for tenant access token calls, permissions must be enabled in the Developer Console.

access.production_restrictions: Enterprise admin security and access controls still apply to app management.
